description.value: A neighbourhood sports pub and casual eatery in Mission that has been serving the community since 1977. The pub features a broad selection of Pacific Northwest craft beers, daily food and drink specials, multiple big-screen TVs for sports, and an attached liquor store open 365 days a year. Live bands perform every second Saturday and karaoke runs every Friday, making it a lively stop for an evening meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at 14thavenue.ca is fully accessible and confirms an active neighbourhood pub and liquor store at 32516 14 Ave, Mission, BC V2V 2N7, matching the OSM address exactly. The site provides two phone numbers (pub: 604-826-0354, liquor store: 604-820-6511) absent from OSM, and the about page confirms the business has been operating since 1977. No bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; the Tuesday taco description ('spicy beef or veggie') provides positive evidence of at least one vegetarian option.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; website lists two numbers (pub: 604-826-0354, liquor store: 604-820-6511).
Some menu prices differ between the front page and the /menu/ subpage (e.g., Sunday burgers $15 vs $12, wings $6.95 vs $6), suggesting portions of the website content may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, long-established neighbourhood pub and liquor store with a functioning website, confirmed address, and food service — clearly a real and publicly accessible business.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Tuesday taco special listed as 'spicy beef or veggie', confirming at least one vegetarian menu item
